title: Automated Training Load Adjustment for Cycling Coaches
business: Endurance cycling coaches managing large rosters of athletes.
problem: Coaches struggle to manually reconcile athlete fatigue data with upcoming training plans, leading to inefficient recovery periods or overtraining risks.
solution: Using the Tredict plugin, coaches can programmatically query athlete workout analysis and push structured workout adjustments directly into the training calendar based on recent physiological trends.
steps: Authenticate the Tredict plugin within the ChatGPT interface to link the coach account.
Query the athlete's recent workout analysis data to identify fatigue markers.
Generate a modified training plan based on the identified recovery needs.
Push the updated structured workouts to the Tredict platform via the plugin interface.
outcome: Coaches achieve a more responsive training environment where plans adapt dynamically to athlete performance data without manual spreadsheet reconciliation.
limitation: The plugin relies on the quality of uploaded workout data; if an athlete fails to sync their device, the analysis will be based on stale information, which can be verified by checking the last sync timestamp in the Tredict dashboard.
